cc:Work.dc:title: FlexBox - RoundedRegularBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
Regular polygon box with rounded vertical edges.
![Lids off](static/samples/RoundedRegularBox2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RoundedRegularBox --sides 4 --inner_size 100 --h 50 --radius 5 --wallpieces 1 --top closed --thickness 3 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RoundedRegularBox --sides --inner_size --h --radius --wallpieces --top --reference --labels
